tonight.title: The Odyssey
tonight.why: Tonight, brace yourself for 'Godzilla Minus Zero,' where Japan's post-war recovery is brutally interrupted by the king of monsters. This isn't just a kaiju flick; it's a visceral, human story of survival against an unstoppable, atomic nightmare.

releases.title: Resident Evil
releases.take: A medical courier's worst night delivers more than just packages; it delivers pure, relentless chaos.

releases.title: Model Citizen
releases.take: Amnesia, an isolated farm, and escalating paranoia prove that sometimes, the past isn't just forgotten, it's hunted.

releases.title: Heart of the Beast
releases.take: Stranded in Alaska with only his loyal combat dog, a Special Forces officer learns that the wild has no mercy for man or beast.

critic.title: The Odyssey
critic.blurb: For a truly sharp take on media ethics, 'Primetime' delivers a scathing indictment of reality TV's hunger for spectacle over genuine justice. It's a chilling, thought-provoking narrative that reveals the monsters lurking behind the lens.
